name: Standex International
outlook:
What Standex International says to expect

  • Second quarter fiscal 2027: revenue and marginIn fiscal second quarter 2027, on a year-on-year basis, the Company expects moderately higher revenue and adjusted operating margin.
  • Fiscal year 2027: sales and adjusted earningsFor fiscal year 2027, the Company is raising its outlook to high-single digits total sales growth, from mid-to-high single digits previously. The Company now anticipates organic sales to increase by more than $100 million in fiscal year 2027. The Company expects higher sales and adjusted operating margin expansion to drive high teens growth in adjusted earnings per share.
  • Second quarter fiscal 2027: interest expenseIn fiscal second quarter 2027, the Company expects interest expense between $7.0 million and $7.5 million.
  • Fiscal year 2027: capital expendituresThe Company expects fiscal year 2027 capital expenditures between $45 million and $55 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 30, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
